requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (InsightFlow) that embeds LLM features across product (in-app support assistant, document summarization, semantic search). Primary goals: maintain <150ms p50 chat latency for UI flows, sustain ~200 qps for embeddings/rerank async workloads, and keep per-1M token spend under $1,200 for production traffic. Preference for starting on Hosted API for speed of integration, then migrate to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable unit economics. Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, and EU data residency for some enterprise customers. Interested in Redwood's automatic prefix/KV caching and smart batching to hit latency/cost targets. Quantization profile evaluation requested (compare fp16 -> int8/4bit).
